author: HBO Max
description:
Hosts Dr. Alok Patel and Hunter Harris sit down with Isa Briones and Gerran Howell (Trinity Santos and Dennis Whitaker) and talk about Season 2 Episode 5 of The Pitt. Then Hunter and Alok speak with production designer Nina Ruscio, and set decorator Matt Callahan, about The Pitt’s set design elements.

Stream new episodes of #ThePitt Thursdays at 9pm ET on HBO Max.
